 Advertisement Election Day 2026 weather forecast: Nov. 3 maps and tracker
 Here are all the maps you need before you head to the polls.
 By Rob Shackelford • 3 hours ago Updated: October 30, 2026, 2:33 pm EDT Published: October 30, 2026, 5:00 am EDT Share Share
 1 . Tuesday morning Chevron Down ( Photo by Ryan Murphy/AFP via Getty Images )
 Millions will be heading to the polls for Election Day on Tuesday, Nov. 3. 
 A storm system will bring showers and a few thunderstorms to the Central U.S., including Chicago, Minneapolis, Kansas City and Dallas. Temperatures could be on the chilly side from the Northwest to Rockies and far northern Upper Midwest, but they'll rebound to comfortable levels by the afternoon.
